Georeferenced tif of the Map of southern tip of Vancouver Island from Sooke Bay to Cordova Bay, c.1853.
Some placenames: Albert Head, Becher Bay, Beechy Head, Clover Point, Foul Bay, Gonzales Point, Metchosin, Pedder Bay, Sooke, William Head
